node.title: E22 cross-scale support canonical form
node.statement: For any E22 staircase support R, the set of quotient moduli M>t for which R has a tail-plus-full-M-fibers representation is recovered canonically from R by taking all M with tail B_M=R minus the union of full M-fibers contained in R satisfying |B_M|<M. Equal-support cross-scale representations therefore have the same canonical support-scale data.
node.attack_surface: fixed-scale full-fiber recovery applied simultaneously over all quotient moduli
node.falsifier: a support R with a staircase representation at M that is not recovered by the full-fiber/tail rule, or equal supports with different canonical scale data
